name: A-Identity Trust Oracle
description: Before one AI agent pays another, it calls A-Identity to check the counterparty: its on-chain ERC-8004 identity, a deterministic 0 to 1000 reputation computed from real settlements, and an ALLOW, WARN or DENY verdict for the specific payment. Where both sides hold a Self Agent ID it also says whether one human stands behind both. On Celo the trust tools are paid per call in USDC over x402, settled through the first-party Celo facilitator.

services.name: web
services.description: Check an ERC-8004 agent on Celo from a browser wallet: one risk_check, paid with a gasless USDC signature.

services.name: web
services.description: risk_check over x402 v2: POST the payee, get a 402 challenge, pay 0.005 USDC on Celo with an EIP-3009 signature, and get ALLOW, WARN or DENY with reasons.

services.name: MCP
services.description: Trust tools for agents: verify_agent, reputation_score, risk_check, counterparty_check and agent_passport.
